floorPlans.note: Plot dimensions and future extensions on the diagrams are separate from the villa’s signed total area. Optional pools and owner works depend on the home.

review.images: The exact Fay Al Reeman II developer brochure identifies the villa and community images. JPEG 2000 originals were preserved as evidence and exported losslessly to WebP. The wider Alreeman plot development and the earlier Fay release were kept separate.
review.location: The right-hand map panel on physical page 4 marks Fay Al Reeman II. Property Finder reports the three displayed area estimates. Alnair’s different reported timing for Ferrari World Roof Walk illustrates route variance. No verified gate pin.
review.floorPlans: Verified all eight full plans and the Type 1 and Type 2 identifiers on physical pages 30–37. The diagrams print plot dimensions and options for owner installation. The brochure does not tie signed total areas to the illustrations, and portal listings use separate letter codes.

unavailable: Verified villa gate coordinates and signed unit-specific total areas.
